patterns.description: In the break, the edit cuts every 2 beats (1.42 s at 85 BPM); 2 of 3 shots follow it.
Cutting speeds up when the drop hits: 0.00 -> 1.05 cuts per second.
Blur effects hit on the beat (2 of 3).
Rotate effects hit on the beat (2 of 3).
Opens with on-screen text ("E bIT Z") in the first second to hook viewers.
The edit cuts away and comes back to the same clip 9 times (source groups A, F, G, H, Q).
